verdict.rationale: Brave Search API supports free-text/natural-language search queries and ships an official MCP server (and Claude/OpenClaw/Dify integration guides) that let AI agents invoke search via natural-language prompts, plus an LLM Context endpoint built for machine consumption. However, the NL interface itself is provided by the calling agent/LLM, not the API, and there's no evidence of broader NL-driven configuration or commands beyond search retrieval. Missing for 10: evidence of NL-driven control over non-search operations, first-party benchmarking of NL query success, and independent hands-on verification of the MCP integration's reliability.
